tools.name: extract_url

tools.description: PDF to structured Markdown. Free quote (pages+route+final price) then x402 pay: text-embedded PDFs flat $0.005/document, scanned OCR $0.012/page. Auto-routes born-digital vs scanned (Japanese-strong OCR).
